title: Revolution of Dignity
summary: Protests in Kyiv's Independence Square began on 21 November 2013 after President Viktor Yanukovych refused to sign the EU association agreement, and grew into a movement against his rule. Most of the 108 officially counted victims died from gunfire on 20 February 2014; Yanukovych fled the capital that month.

uncertainty.note: The id carries 2010 only as a lookup key; both sources date the events to November 2013 to February 2014.

importance.justification: Ukraine's second post-Soviet revolution; it removed President Yanukovych and reoriented the country toward the EU.

audience_note: Protesters and police were killed, mostly by gunfire, in the final days of the uprising.
